messages.content: Write the introduction to a guide for a REST API that manages calendar bookings. Around 200 words.

The Calendar Bookings API enables applications to manage time-based reservations programmatically. Whether you're building a scheduling platform, integrating booking capabilities into an existing application, or automating appointment workflows, this API provides a complete set of endpoints to create, retrieve, update, and cancel bookings.

The API follows REST conventions and uses JSON for request and response bodies. All communication occurs over HTTPS, and authentication uses API keys passed in request headers. Responses include consistent status codes and error messages to help you handle edge cases reliably.

Key capabilities include creating bookings with customizable time slots and metadata, querying available time windows to prevent double-bookings, modifying existing reservations, and canceling bookings with optional notification triggers. The API supports pagination for listing operations and webhooks for real-time updates when bookings change.

Before making requests, you'll need an API key from your dashboard. Every endpoint requires authentication, and requests are rate-limited to prevent abuse. Responses include standard HTTP headers indicating cache behavior and rate-limit status.

This guide covers authentication, available endpoints, request/response formats, error handling, and common use cases. Code examples are provided in popular languages, and a sandbox environment lets you test integrations before deploying to production.
